title: Crystal Combination
statementMd:
Elaina, a magic teacher, has prepared an exam with t𝑡 questions. In each question, given a target magic power x𝑥, a student must combine exactly two magic crystals with powers 2a2𝑎 and 2b2𝑏 for some non-negative integers a𝑎 and b𝑏 (possibly a=b𝑎=𝑏), and report the minimum possible difference between the combined power and x𝑥, that is, |2a+2b−x|∣∣2𝑎+2𝑏−𝑥∣∣. Please help the students finish the exam.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t𝑡. The description of the test cases follows.

The only line of each test case contains one integer x𝑥, representing the target magic power.

- 1≤t≤1041≤𝑡≤104
- 1≤x≤10181≤𝑥≤1018

## Output

For each test case, output one integer: the minimum possible difference between the combined power and x𝑥, that is, |2a+2b−x|.
